title: ChatBEV: Empowering Traffic Scene Understanding and Simulation via Vision-Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2503.13938v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Comprehensive traffic scene understanding is a foundational capability for Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) underpinning applications such as traffic simulation. While VisionLanguage Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning potential, their application to Bird's-Eye View (BEV) maps in traffic contexts remains limited by narrow task definitions and scarce annotated data. We introduce ChatBEV-QA, a large-scale BEV VQA benchmark of 137K+ QA pairs, designed to evaluate global scene understanding, vehicle-lane interactions, and vehiclevehicle interactions within complex traffic environments. Building on this, we fine-tune ChatBEV, a specialized VLM that accurately interprets diverse scene understanding queries from BEV maps. translated_title: ChatBEV：基于视觉-语言模型赋能交通场景理解与仿真
translated_abstract: 全面的交通场景理解是智能交通系统（ITS）的基础能力，支撑着交通仿真等诸多应用。尽管视觉-语言模型（VLM）已展现出强大的推理潜力，但其在交通场景中鸟瞰图（BEV）地图上的应用仍受限于狭窄的任务定义和稀缺的标注数据。我们提出了ChatBEV-QA，一个包含超过13.7万个问答对的大规模BEV视觉问答基准，旨在评估复杂交通环境中的全局场景理解、车辆-车道交互以及车辆-车辆交互。在此基础上，我们微调得到ChatBEV——一个专门化的VLM，能够准确解读来自BEV地图的多样化场景理解查询。为展示其在ITS应用中的下游实用性，我们将ChatBEV集成到一个语言引导的交通仿真框架中，其全局理解与导航推理能力提供了关键的……
tldr: 本文提出了大规模BEV视觉问答基准ChatBEV-QA及专门化的视觉-语言模型ChatBEV，实现了对交通场景的全局理解、车辆交互分析，并将其集成到语言引导的交通仿真框架中，赋能智能交通系统。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ChatBEV-QA, a large-scale BEV VQA benchmark with 137K+ QA pairs, and ChatBEV, a specialized vision-language model for comprehensive traffic scene understanding, which is further integrated into a language-guided traffic simulation framework to empower intelligent transportation systems.
